notes: Observation dates may be older than the dashboard generation time.
Resource freshness and observation freshness are separate checks.
Lakeport lake-level values are shown as feet Rumsey, with approximate elevation calculated using Zero Rumsey = 1318.256 ft above mean sea level.
FHABS report counts represent reporting activity, not direct bloom intensity.
This manifest describes the generated public-data snapshot and is not official public-health guidance.

fieldDefinitions.generatedAt: Dashboard snapshot generation time. This describes when the public JSON files were built, not when lake conditions were observed.
fieldDefinitions.sourceFreshnessMaxAgeDays: Review threshold used by validation to warn when source observations are older than the dashboard freshness window.
fieldDefinitions.latestObservationDate: Observation freshness field. This is the newest environmental observation date available for a source within the public snapshot.
fieldDefinitions.resourceDate: Resource freshness field for downloadable source files. This is the date embedded in the source file URL or release, not an environmental observation date.
fieldDefinitions.resourceAgeDays: Resource freshness field for downloadable source files. This is how old the source file was when the dashboard snapshot was generated.
fieldDefinitions.status: Machine-readable source load status for the snapshot refresh pass.

freshnessLegend.definition: When Clear Lake Watch generated these public JSON files.
How recent the newest environmental record is for a source.
